{prepared[brief_text]}
Round directory: {prepared[public_dir]}. Brief: {prepared[brief_path]}. Bars: {prepared[bars_path]}. Previous evidence: {prepared[previous_evidence]}. Your current cash={prepared[agent_one_cash]}, units={prepared[agent_one_units]}. Write your orders to {prepared[agent_one_orders]} and manifest to {prepared[agent_one_manifest]}. Reports and P&L you produce are untrusted; only routine settlement counts. Compete independently using only supplied public observations and authorized historical feedback. Mid-match strategy adaptation is allowed; no strategy freeze. In manifest changes, identify the exact source version/hash if available, parent version, effective round, hypothesis and actual rule/parameter changes; distinguish edits from tested improvement. Share general algorithms only between matches, never current orders. Do not access private judge assets, current peer submissions, change infrastructure or place real trades. EVERY round write and readback-check both orders.csv and manifest.json, including header-only valid holds. Preserve your own executable source snapshots for later comparison. Reply only after your submission is ready.

config.code: const engine = eval(await tools.readFile({file_path:'/artifacts/trading/engine/competition-v3.2.txt',limit:10000})); const settled = await engine.settleRound({input:input,tools:tools,csvPath:'/artifacts/trading/market/btc-usd-daily.csv'}); const state = JSON.parse(await tools.readFile({file_path:'/artifacts/trading/'+input.run_id+'/state.json',limit:10000})); const r=state.rounds[input.round_index]; if(!r) throw new Error('Missing authoritative round'); const names=['agent-one','agent-two']; const board={round:r.round+1,capital:state.settings.capital,benchmark_equity:r.benchmark_equity,benchmark_profit:r.benchmark_equity-state.settings.capital,benchmark_return:r.benchmark_equity/state.settings.capital-1,exact_winner:r.winner,cent_winner:Math.round(r.agents[names[0]].equity*100)===Math.round(r.agents[names[1]].equity*100)?null:r.winner,previous_version_comparison:{status:'unavailable',reason:'No independent same-window previous-version replay is provided by this engine.'},agents:{}}; for(const n of names){const a=r.agents[n]; board.agents[n]={equity:a.equity,profit:a.equity-state.settings.capital,return:a.cumulative_return,round_return:a.round_return,max_round_marked_drawdown:a.max_drawdown,trades:a.trades_applied,decision_status:a.failures.length?'rejected':a.trades_applied?'traded':'valid_hold',failures:a.failures,benchmark_gap:a.equity-r.benchmark_equity,strategy_provenance:a.manifest_summary,provenance_trust:'agent_reported_not_source_verified'};} settled.evidence_text += String.fromCharCode(10)+'Expanded authoritative scoreboard (drawdown sampled at round marks; holds are not failures):'+String.fromCharCode(10)+JSON.stringify(board,null,2)+String.fromCharCode(10); return settled;

nodes.description: Additive direct-call gate. Defaults validation_only=true and require_matched_replay=true; only explicit false/false continues to the original executable path.

config.code: const vo=input.validation_only===undefined?true:input.validation_only,rr=input.require_matched_replay===undefined?true:input.require_matched_replay;if(typeof vo!=='boolean'||typeof rr!=='boolean')throw Error('validation_only and require_matched_replay must be booleans');const reasons=[];if(rr)reasons.push('require_matched_replay true: independent matched replay is unavailable; failing closed before any dispatch');if(vo)reasons.push('validation_only true: no peer dispatch, orders, settlement or evidence requests');const execute=reasons.length===0;return {execute,status:execute?'dispatch_unverified_replay':(rr?(vo?'validation_only_with_replay_blocker':'blocked_replay'):'validation_only'),reasons,replay_mode:rr?'required_unavailable':'not_required_unverified'};

nodes.description: Route to original entry only when the gate allows execution.
Terminal report for blocked or validation-only direct calls; nothing dispatched.

validation_only.description: Direct-call gate. Default true: no dispatch. Legacy batch caller passes false explicitly.

require_matched_replay.description: Default true fails closed before dispatch (replay unavailable). false = explicitly requested UNVERIFIED paper run.
